name: WISE-RONIN Literal Questions / Manual Answers

method.question: Copy the original question verbatim. Never normalize, translate, repair, shorten, or paraphrase it.
method.answer: Write a new answer manually. Preserve the source answer's meaning; syntax and voice may change, facts may not.
method.provenance: Manual rows keep dataset, pinned revision, split, source ID, exact question and question hash. The pinned source queue retains context, reference answers and offsets.
method.training: Only source train rows with author_status=manually_reviewed can be exported to SFT.
method.evaluation: Validation/dev/test data are never admitted to the training export.

sources.name: Spanish Question Answering Corpus
sources.license_note: Use conservative CC BY-SA attribution. The corpus card describes source texts with mixed upstream licensing; preserve source attribution and do not strip source metadata.

sources.name: ESQAD EVAU manually curated subset
sources.note: The EVAU subset is manually curated. Other ESQAD subsets (Quijote, Legal FAQs, pilot exams) have different generation/validation characteristics and must remain separately labelled.

warning: This is a manual-authoring dataset in progress, not a claim that the full source corpus has already been rewritten.
